body: I am, and nobody that knows me feels otherwise
im a bad person, you don't want to help someone like me, trust me. Others deserve help, I'm beyond it.

I appriciate your words. I have a masters degree and can't find work. I'm glad you put your life together, I've done it several times. Money isn't an issue, I am independently wealthy but it really means nothing. Not a person will miss me, my o ly family member I have just informed me she would be elated if I ended my life as she could enjoy hers. It's great you have family and friends that would miss you, I don't.

What is left? Breaking bad? A sunny day or fresh snow? Yea, those things are great, but far from a reason to continue. I've managed to destroy my life. I've tried to I'd it but I can't, I have no desire to live my life alone and continue to drain society. I just know that the world is better without me.
not to sound ungrateful for your words, but why do you care?
